description: Searchable home database: appliances, breakers, repairs, warranties, measurements, receipts, filters, paint colors, shutoffs.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: Every homeowner re-discovers the filter size and water shutoff — the searchable house memory is genuinely useful. But it's consulted twice a year, which makes $4/mo a subscription for a reference book. This is a feature of a home-services app or an insurer perk, not a standalone.
Ask returns answer; Add item opens; zero errors.

notes.change: 'Upcoming maintenance' schedule auto-generated from catalog data — Next due/Flush due/Renewal dates, interval math (Replace every 90d + Last replaced), warranty-expiry alerts, sorted with relative-time badges (README next-3 #3). 'Maintenance due < 60 days' KPI now computed, not hardcoded. Fixed pre-existing search bug: results were prepended so worst match showed first despite 'best first' label. Ask got data-core.
